8155.title: Question prompts bypass Markdown rendering
8155.rootCauseOneLine: The shared question form inserts the prompt as plain text, so Markdown is not parsed and normal whitespace collapses its newlines.
8155.proposedFix: Reuse the existing host Markdown renderer for visible question prompts; preserve answer handling and the accessible legend.
8155.caveats: Component-boundary reproduction repeated in two clean trusted checkouts; no live OMP/macOS session was replayed.
